ns2:section.sectionText: Second 8 weeks 3/13/17-5/3/17 Attendance to weekly meetings online via video-chat will be required. Students will be asked to sign up for one of the following time slots: F 9:00-10:30 am, or F 6:00-7:30 pm. This section has one proctored exam completed online, which may carry additional fees. Some seats are reserved for off campus students. Remaining seats will be release by 8:00 a.m. on Monday, 11/14/16.
